# Train a classifier on iris dataset
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
ds <- list(x=data.matrix(iris[1:4]),y=iris$Species)

fm <- nn_cell_scorer |>
  setup(
    optimizer = optim_adam,
    metrics = list(
      luz_metric_accuracy()
    ),
    loss = nn_multi_margin_loss(margin=1)
  ) |>
  set_hparams(colnames(ds$x),levels(ds$y)) |>
  set_opt_hparams(weight_decay=0,lr=0.001) |>
  fit(
    epoch = 300L,
    data = ds,
    valid_data = ds,
    accelerator = accelerator(cpu = TRUE),
    callbacks = list(
      luz_callback_lr_scheduler(lr_lambda,verbose=TRUE,function(epoch) {0.1^(((epoch * 4L) %/% 150L) %% 4L)}),
      luz_callback_prune("layer1.linear.weight",n=1,at_epoch=149L)
    )
  )


#luz_save(fm,"model.luz")
```


```{r eval=FALSE}
plot(fm)
```


```{r eval=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#rec <- lr_finder(fm,ds,accelerator=accelerator(cpu = TRUE))
predict(fm,ds,accelerator = accelerator(cpu = TRUE))$max(dim=2)[[2]] |> 
  as_array() |>
  table(iris$Species)
```


```{r eval=FALSE}
train <- sce_set[, sample(seq(1:dim(sce_set)[2]), size = dim(sce_set)[2]*0.7)]
test <- sce_set[, !colnames(sce_set) %in% colnames(train)]
```


```{r eval=FALSE}

train_ds <- x_y_delayed_dataset(t(logcounts(train)), as.matrix(as.integer(as.factor(train$subclass_label))),
                            dtypes = list(torch_float(), torch_long()))

test_ds <- x_y_delayed_dataset(t(logcounts(test)), as.matrix(as.numeric(as.factor(test$subclass_label))),
                          dtypes = list(torch_float(), torch_long()))
```



```{r warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
fitted <- nn_cell_scorer |>
  setup(
    optimizer = optim_adam,
    metrics = list(
      luz_metric_accuracy()
    ),
    loss = nn_multi_margin_loss(margin=1)
  ) |>
  set_hparams(feature_names=rownames(train), class_names=train$subclass_label) |>
  set_opt_hparams(weight_decay=0, lr=0.001) |>
  fit(
    epoch = 100L,
    data = train_ds,
    valid_data = test_ds,
    dataloader_options=list(batch_size=100L),
    accelerator = accelerator(cpu = TRUE),
    callbacks = list(
      luz_callback_lr_scheduler(lr_lambda,verbose=TRUE,function(epoch) {0.1^(((epoch * 4L) %/% 50L) %% 4L)}),
      luz_callback_prune("layer1.linear.weight",n=1,at_epoch=49L)
    )
  )


```



```{r}

#' @title train_torch_NN
#' @description Allows user-friendly training set up of a torch model.
#' @param x Count matrix.
#' @param y Array containing the cell type class label.
#' @param batch_size Size of data loaded at training.
#' @param epoch Number of epochs.
#' @param train_size Size for the training set. Default to 70%.
#' @param random_state Value to set random seed. Default to 12.
#' @export

train_cell_scorer <- function(x, y, n_epoch=100L, batch_size=100L, train_size=0.7, random_state=12){
  
  ds <- train_test_split(x,y, train_size = train_size, random_state = random_state)
  
  train_ds <- x_y_delayed_dataset(x=ds$x_train, y=as.matrix(as.integer(as.factor(ds$y_train))), dtypes = list(torch_float(), torch_long()))
  test_ds <- x_y_delayed_dataset(x=ds$x_test, y=as.matrix(as.integer(as.factor(ds$y_test))), dtypes = list(torch_float(), torch_long()))
  
  sch_epoch <- round(n_epoch/2)
  prune_epoch <- sch_epoch-1
  # browser()
  
  f <- nn_cell_scorer |>
    setup(optimizer=optim_adam,
          metrics = list(luz_metric_accuracy()),
          loss=nn_multi_margin_loss(margin = 1)
          ) |>
    set_hparams(feature_names=colnames(train_ds$x), class_names=ds$y_train) |>
    set_opt_hparams(weight_decay=0, lr=0.001) |>
    fit(
      epoch = n_epoch,
      data = train_ds,
      valid_data = test_ds,
      dataloader_options = list(batch_size=batch_size),
      accelerator = accelerator(cpu=TRUE),
      callbacks = list(
        luz_callback_lr_scheduler(lr_lambda, verbose=TRUE, function(epoch) {0.1^(((epoch * 4L) %/% sch_epoch) %% 4L)}),
        luz_callback_prune("layer1.linear.weight", n=1, at_epoch=prune_epoch)
        )
    )
}

```

do.call

```{r}
train_test_split <- function(x, y, train_size=0.7, random_state=12){
  set.seed(random_state)
  i <- sample(seq(1:nrow(x)), size = nrow(x)*train_size)
  x_train <- x[i, ]
  y_train <- y[i]
  x_test <- x[-i, ]
  y_test <- y[-i]
  return(list(x_train=x_train, y_train=y_train, x_test=x_test, y_test=y_test))
  
}
```
